description: Who mines a mineral, who holds its reserves, and who exports it — USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries production and reserves by country, joined to UN Comtrade export flows and realised unit values, with supply concentration and US net import reliance. REFUSES three things: no ratio between the supply side and the trade side, because USGS counts contained metal while HS counts the gross weight of a traded article and for lithium those differ by about five times; no price of any kind; no criticality or supply-risk score. EXPORTS ARE NOT PRODUCTION — for gold and silver the largest reporters refine and vault rather than mine, so the two halves rank different countries for good reasons. The HS code matches the USGS production basis, so copper, nickel and zinc point at ore and concentrate headings rather than the refined-metal headings their instruments use. Annual data. Paid.
